description: Microrregião de Caxias do Sul – risco geológico por declividade - vetores is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Declividade obtida o modelo digital de elevação do Copernicus 30 m de resolução espacial. Dado reclassificado em intervalos de declive dos terrenos com risco para alagamentos ou encharcamentos, bem como para escorregamentos. Os dados foram recortados pelo limite da Microrregião de Caxias do Sul (camada de máscara). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are declividade classificada, Microrregião Caxias do Sul, Brazil, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
